title: PAI-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark For Physical AI

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models with zero input frames (text-only input) to determine if they can exploit strong textual priors to infer answers without actual visual grounding.

Comparing model performance across varying input frame counts (e.g., 1-frame versus 32-frame inputs) to assess whether questions can be answered using only a single static frame rather than requiring temporal context comprehension.
